common:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D animated desktop companion sprite sheet.
Create a SIX-FRAME animation sprite sheet, exact layout 3 columns by 2 rows with six equal square cells, total canvas 1536x1024. The attached images are visual references only, not parts to paste.
Character is the EARLY Shenshen design: a cute watercolor chibi young man, black parted hair with small forehead tuft, large dark eyes, plain orange cat-ear hood with white inner rim, orange collared button shirt and a black necktie, little black terminal badge on chest, BLACK LONG TROUSERS, black belt with small silver chain, white fluffy fingerless gloves and orange boots with white fluffy ankle cuffs. Preserve face, body proportions, outfit and watercolor line style exactly. Do NOT change to hoodie, shorts, shoulder bag, cat-face hat or pom-poms.
Each cell contains one complete full-body character at the same scale, centered on the same x position, generous empty margins, never touching cell boundaries. Baseline for grounded poses is near 85% of cell height. Read frames left-to-right across first row then second row. These must be genuine successive hand-drawn animation poses with limb/face changes, not copies translated or stretched.
Background truly transparent alpha, including around and between cells. No checkerboard, white fill, backdrop, floor shadow, panel borders, labels, typography, extra characters or watermark. Only the character and explicitly requested laptop are visible. Maintain exactly six isolated characters.
